authority_levels.name: official_authority
authority_levels.description: Official institution, government, provider, or verified domain source.

authority_levels.name: direct_verified_provider_evidence
authority_levels.description: Direct evidence from a verified partner, employer, accommodation owner, institution, or provider.

authority_levels.name: public_aggregator
authority_levels.description: Public directory, job board, bursary platform, accommodation platform, or non-official aggregator.

authority_levels.name: social_or_community_lead
authority_levels.description: Social media post, WhatsApp rumour, user-submitted name, community lead, or screenshot.

authority_levels.name: unknown_or_unverified
authority_levels.description: Source identity, owner, provider, or claim cannot yet be verified.

claim_levels.name: general_kingsmen_service_claim
examples: Kingsmen helps map routes, documents, accommodation needs, CV readiness, and source checks.

claim_levels.name: stable_public_route_fact
examples: TVET colleges are part of the public post-school system.
NSFAS funding is separate from admission.

claim_levels.name: named_route_anchor
examples: UJ, DUT, UKZN, UNISA, TVET colleges, Services SETA, NSFAS.
claim_levels.restriction: Must not imply partnership, current opening, acceptance, funding, job, or accommodation availability.

claim_levels.name: specific_current_claim
examples: A learnership closes on a specific date

hard_blocks: Do not publish unverified fees, deadlines, payment instructions, funding status, application status, accommodation deposits, or current openings.
Do not mark social/community leads as verified truth.
Do not use success stories without proof and candidate consent.
Do not imply official partnership without evidence.
Do not show unverified accommodation as verified.
Do not guarantee acceptance, funding, jobs, bursaries, accommodation, or success.

source_lead_default.candidate_safe_warning: Do not pay, travel, send documents, or apply blindly until this source is verified. Kingsmen will check source confidence and show safer next actions where possible.
